remarks: Discover this stunning 5 bedroom, 4.1 bathroom residence, beautifully set in a tranquil pond setting, offering unparalleled landscaping. Sunlight fills the open, airy spaces of the home, highlighting sophisticated design and new features throughout. The state-of-the-art kitchen complements gorgeous new baths, newer utilities, and an option to have the primary suite on the first or second floor ensures modern comfort. Expansive outdoor areas invite relaxation, and the versatile lower level functions as a self-contained apartment, perfect for guests or extended family. This home blends elegance, functionality, and serene beauty seamlessly.
